WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cp.category, cp.subcategory, p.category AS cat_then, p.subcategory AS sub_then, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    AND (cp.category='Garden' OR p.category='Garden')
)

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) nret
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 20

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT dt.fiscal_year, dt.fiscal_quarter, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) dup_rows, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, MIN(etl_loaded_at) e1, MAX(etl_loaded_at) e2, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_date dt ON dt.calendar_date=f.sale_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id=900 AS is_web, w.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.sales_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) returned_lines, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) e1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) e2
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sales_line_id FROM fact_return_line) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category='Garden'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, cp.subcategory, p.subcategory AS sub_then, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
      AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS sold_net,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0),2) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM((l.subcategory<>l.sub_then)::INT) AS lines_changed_subcat
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
